harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «تنزيل».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «ما خلقنا» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلقنا»; «وأجل» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «الحق». «ما» in «عَمَّا» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «معرضون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: His words «أرأيتم» mean "tell me", and it takes two objects: the first is the relative «ما», and the second is the clause «ماذا خلقوا». The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». His words «ماذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «ذا» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate). The preposition «من الأرض» is attached to «خلقوا». The clause «أروني» is parenthetical, reinforcing «أرأيتم». «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شرك». The clause «ائتوني» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The preposition «من قبل» is attached to a naʿt of «كتاب», and the preposition «من علم» is attached to a naʿt of «أثارة». The clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «ومن أضل» is resumptive; «من»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: i.e. «من» is the mubtadaʾ and «أضل» its khabar]. The preposition «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أضل»; the preposition «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ»; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, the object of «يدعو». The clause «وهم غافلون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «لا يستجيب», and the preposition «عن دعائهم» is attached to «غافلون».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The conditional clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause «مَنْ أضل»; the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أعداء»; and the preposition «بعبادتهم» is attached to «كافرين».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آياتنا». The clause «لما جاءهم» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb) of «لما» is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «هذا سحر» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one. The clause «فلا تملكون» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "you do not possess", and the clause (فأنتم لا تملكون) is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيئاً». The clause «هو أعلم» is resumptive; the clause «كفى به شهيداً» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the hāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and «شهيداً» is a tamyīz (specification). The adverb «بيني» is attached to «شهيداً», and the clause «وهو الغفور الرحيم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كفى به».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition «من الرسل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بدعاً». The clause «ما أدري» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying). His words «ما يفعل بي»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause suspends «أدري» from governing, so it stands in place of its two objects. «إن» is negative; the clause «إن أتبع» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «وما أنا إلا نذير» is conjoined to the clause «أتبع».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The two objects of «أرأيتم» are omitted, i.e. "Have you considered your state: if it were so, would you not be wrongdoers?" The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then you have done wrong". The clause «وشهد شاهد» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كفرتم»; the preposition «من بني» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شاهد»; the preposition «على مثله» is attached to «شهد»; and the clause «فآمن» is conjoined to the clause «شهد».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «وقال» is resumptive, and the conditional clause is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying); the noun (ism) of «كان» refers to the Qur'an. His words «وإذ»: the wāw is conjunctive; «إذ» is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "their obstinacy became evident when they were not guided", and the clause of the implied verb is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «قال». It is not attached to his words «فسيقولون», because the two times differ and because what follows the fāʾ does not govern what precedes it. The clause «فسيقولون» is conjoined to the clause of the implied verb.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «ومن قبله كتاب» is resumptive; «إماماً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كتاب موسى». The clause «وهذا كتاب» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the resumptive clause. «لساناً» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «مصدق»; the ḥāl here is a non-derived noun, and its being qualified is what permits it. The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لينذر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مصدق»; «بشرى» is a noun conjoined to «مصدق», and the preposition «للمحسنين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرى».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «استقاموا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «قالوا»; the clause «فلا خوف» is the khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ»; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and «لا» is negative and inoperative (muhmala).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «أصحاب»; «جزاء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governing word is implied, i.e. "they are recompensed with a recompense"; the preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «جزاء».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «ووصينا» is resumptive; «إحساناً» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being "that he do good to them with good". The clause «حملته أمه» is resumptive; «كرهاً» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. "a carrying in hardship". The clause «وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «حملته أمه». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive; «أربعين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «قال» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «أوزعني» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «أن» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the second object, and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first. «صالحاً» is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «ترضاه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صالحاً». The clause «إني تبت» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «أولئك الذين»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition «في أصحاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عنهم». «وعد» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the clause (نَعِدهم وَعْدَ) is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «نتقبَّل». «الصدق» is muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «والذي قال......» is resumptive. «أف»: a verbal noun of imperfect meaning (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ), meaning "I am vexed". The preposition «لكما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied "I mean", i.e. "the saying of 'uff' is to you two". The clause «أتعدانني» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أخرج» is the second object of «تَعِدانني». The clause «وقد خلت» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause «وهما يستغيثان» is a ḥāl from «والديه». His words «ويلك»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of a disused (muhmal) verb, and the clause «ويلك آمن» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying which is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) in «يستغيثان», i.e. "they say: woe to you, believe". The clause «آمن» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, as is the clause «إن وعد الله حق». The clause «فيقول» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the implied clause of saying; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «أساطير» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «أولئك الذين» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذي» in the previous verse. The preposition «في أمم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليهم»; the clause «قد خَلَتْ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمم»; the preposition «من الجن» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلت»; and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «ولكل درجات» is resumptive; the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «درجات». The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليوفيهم» is attached to an implied verb, i.e. "He recompensed them with that", and the implied clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «لكل درجات». The clause «وهم لا يظلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: His words «ويوم»: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied verb, i.e. "it will be said to them on the day". The clause «يعرض» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «أذهبتم» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of an implied saying; the preposition «في حياتكم» is attached to «أذهبتم». His words «فاليوم»: the fāʾ is conjunctive and «اليوم» is an adverb attached to «تجزون»; the clause «تجزون» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the implied clause "it will be said". «عذاب» is the second object; «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «تجزون». The preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تستكبرون», and the second interpreted maṣdar «بما كنتم» is conjoined to the first maṣdar.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «واذكر» is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (ishtimāl) from «أخا». The preposition «بالأحقاف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قومه»; the clause «وقد خلت» is a ḥāl. «أن» is explicative (mufassira), and the clause after it is explicative; the clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «فأتنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «جئتنا»; the clause «إن كنت من الصادقين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «وأبلِّغكم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying); «ما» is a relative noun, the second object; «قومًا» is the second object, and the clause «تجهلون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The conditional clause is resumptive. «عارضًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «رأوه»; «مستقبل» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «عارضًا», and its annexation is not pure (ghayr maḥḍa), because it is an active participle; hence it may be a naʿt (adjective) of an indefinite noun. Likewise «مُمْطرنا» is a naʿt of «عارض». «ما» is a relative noun, khabar (predicate) of «هو»; «ريح» is a badal (substitute) from «هو», and the clause «فيها عذاب» is a naʿt of «ريح».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «تدمر» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {رِيحٌ}; the preposition «بأمر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تدمر». The clause «فأصبحوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «تدمر», and the clause «لا يرى» is the khabar (predicate) of the defective (nāqiṣa) «أصبحوا»; «مساكنهم» is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The kāf in «كذلك» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We recompense with a recompense like that recompense", and the clause «نجزي» is parenthetical between the two conjoined clauses.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause of the oath and its response is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {فَأَصْبَحُوا}. «ما» is a relative in the position of the genitive; «إن» is negative, i.e. "We established them in that in which We did not establish you, of power"; the negative «ما» was avoided in favour of «إن» so that two identical words would not come together. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل», and the clause «فما أغنى» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا». «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), emphasising the negation. «وشيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a little or a great sufficing", and «مِنْ» is redundant. «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to «أغنى». The clause «حاق» is conjoined to the clause «ما أغنى»; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the preposition «به» is attached to «يستهزئون».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «ولقد أهلكنا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «لقد مكنَّاهم»; «حولكم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «من القرى» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; and the clause «لعلهم يرجعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «فلولا نصرهم» is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آلهة». The first object of «اتخذوا» is omitted, i.e. "they took them"; «قربانًا» is a ḥāl, and «آلهة» is the second object of «اتخذ». The clause «ضلوا» is resumptive, as is the clause «وذلك إفكهم». His words «ما»: a relative noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «إفكهم».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied "remember". The preposition «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نفراً», and the clause «يستمعون» is a second naʿt of «نفراً». The clause «فلما حضروه» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «صَرَفْنا»; the conditional clause «فلمَّا قضي» is resumptive; «منذرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ولَّوْا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «أنزل» is a naʿt (adjective); «مصدقاً» is a naʿt of «كتاباً»; the lām in «لما» is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); and the clause «يهدي» is a naʿt of «كتاباً».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «يا قومنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the clause «يغفر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «ومن لا يجب» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «آمنوا», the response to the vocative. «من» is conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «فليس بمعجز» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate). The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معجز»; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أولياء»; and the clause «أولئك في ضلال» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive, and «أنَّ» with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «يروا». The clause «ولم يعي» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «خلق», and the verb is jussive (majzūm) by dropping the weak letter. The bāʾ in «بقادر» is redundant (zāʾida); its addition is made acceptable by the statement being equivalent to (أليس الله بقادر؟). The preposition «على أن يحيي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادر». «بلى» is a particle of response, and the clause after it is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "it will be said". The clause «أليس هذا بالحق» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of the implied saying, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ليس». The clause «بلى وَرَبِّنا» (هو الحق) is the maqūl al-qawl; the wāw in «وربِّنا» is of the oath, and the genitive noun is attached to an implied "I swear". The clause «فذوقوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. «إن أقررتم فذوقوا» (if you acknowledge it, then taste); «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to «فذوقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «فاصبر» is resumptive; the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "be patient with a patience like the patience of those of resolve". The preposition «من الرسل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أولو العزم». The clause «كأنهم يوم يرون ... » is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to «يلبثوا»; «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ساعة» is an adverb attached to «يلبثوا»; the preposition «من نهار» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «ساعة». «بلاغ» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a proclamation", and the clause is resumptive, as is the interrogative clause.
